status: draft 2026-10-06: decisions A (targets at epsilon inf) and B (DP arms) are pending; prepare final refuses this file until its status starts with 'frozen'
inherits: Every Stage 0/1 definition (data, arms, measurements, statistics, classification, H1-H7 rules, the cross-channel rule) applies unchanged unless this file tightens it or records a pre-registered change. Nothing is loosened.
role: confirmation on fresh final targets; V, pilot, control, datastore and timing data are never evidence

design.target_rule: fresh final targets in the study's eligible order: the first n at epsilon inf; each DP arm takes the first n_eps of those (paired: every DP target also runs at epsilon inf); seed = 9000 + target index

shared_models.RG-public: 5 seeds on the final cohort (U records), scored on the final F
shared_models.P0: one pretrained model scored on the final F

design.measurements: all pre-registered measurements in every paired job: Reference (both forms recorded; the frozen form decides), retention, utility, the 3-query natural-question pass (both scorers recorded; the frozen scorer decides), 16 N documents, and the causal attack in the arm's frozen direction only

causal.config: validated: cosine, probe_epochs 12, probe_lr 0.005, 40 counterbalanced trials

release_noise.accounting: its own per-release zCDP record; never merged with the training epsilon

design.observation_path: in-process observation trials and release noise drawn on the GPU (core 8b031bbfdcc1 or later): the same releases and scores as the Flower VictimClient path (tested)

gate.calibration: V (Stage 0); recorded at retrieval level only

design.training_nondeterminism: accepted (2026-10-04): GPU training is not bit-reproducible; each world is one random draw carried by the target bootstrap

CB-LM.note: Stage 1 bridge only; not run in Stage 2

attacker_choice_source: Stage 1 pilot (V, seeds 8000-8099, core 4a001c5eb678): per arm, pooling its pilot jobs over all three budgets (decided 2026-10-04); highest pooled tuning AUC, ties to the standard form or the F1 scorer
h4_basis: 6-epoch positive control passed: 10 of 12 learned; retention r 0.142, 95% CI [0.066, 0.225], lower bound > 0.05

hypotheses.H1: as proposal §9.2, at epsilon inf, Reference AUC in the frozen form

H2.primary_endpoint: D = AUC_causal(CB-AO) - AUC_causal(RG) at epsilon inf, mean per-target AUC of the 40-trial release-noise pass (sigma_obs 1.0, C 1.0) in the frozen (template) direction; two-sided, as proposal §9.2
H2.secondary: the same D on the no-noise pass, reported with its interval and reading; it never decides H2
notes: This endpoint was chosen after seeing the Stage 1 pilot: with no noise both arms sat at the causal-AUC ceiling (about 1.0), while the release-noise pass gave RG 0.744 and CB-AO 0.621 at epsilon inf. It is a post-pilot definition change and a new pre-registration.
The no-noise H2 of revision 4 is kept as a reported secondary.
H2 now measures leakage through noise-protected client releases (sigma_obs 1.0), not through raw updates.
Stage 2 uses fresh final targets only, so no pilot target contributes to H2.

hypotheses.H3: as proposal §9.2, natural-question pooled AUC with the frozen scorer (F1 for both arms)
hypotheses.H4: primary; both R_RG and D_H4 must be supported
hypotheses.H5: F1(RG-public) - F1(RG, epsilon inf); secondary against each DP budget that is run
hypotheses.H6: at epsilon 16 (always kept): utility supported and Reference AUC difference lower bound > -0.05
hypotheses.H7: F1(P0) - F1(RG, epsilon inf) on final data; non-inferiority readings as proposal §9.2

statistics.unit: target; paired target bootstrap with all arms together; 10,000 resamples; numpy default_rng(20260930)
statistics.utility_bootstrap: crossed: models (targets or seeds) x final F article clusters, siblings kept together
statistics.classification: first match, six outcomes, as stage01_protocol.json
statistics.cross_channel: H1 supported and (H2 'RG increases' or H3 supported); H4 never counts
statistics.analysis: grounded_fl_study analyze on the completed final launch, once

decisions.C_h2: C2 (2026-10-05): the release-noise pass is H2's primary (above)
